name: Fully Welded Wide Channel Plate Heat Exchanger
full_description: The official page says the fully welded wide channel plate heat exchanger is created for special customer needs and is particularly suitable for media containing large amounts of solid particles, fiber suspensions, and viscous fluids in metallurgy, papermaking, sugar, alcohol, chemical engineering, and sewage treatment processes. The product uses large single plates, with maximum length over 10,000mm and width of 1,200mm. Plate spacing columns are laser welded, long welds are seam welded, outer-end welds use automatic argon arc welding, and each plate pair receives 0.6-0.7MPa air-tightness testing after welding.
advantage: Wide-channel design for solids, fibers, and viscous media.
Large single plate size supports demanding industrial processes.
Laser welding, seam welding, and automatic argon arc welding are used for different weld positions.
Each plate pair receives air-tightness testing after welding.

technical_parameters.Air-Tightness Test: 0.6-0.7MPa after each plate pair is welded
